shortDescription: A magnitude 6.2 quake hit Indonesia's Banda Sea near Maluku Island on Friday, the country's geophysics agency said, adding that there was no tsunami potentialThe epicentre of the quake was 143 km (89 miles) deep, the agency said. There was no immediate report of damages.
